item.text: Publish a simple priority rubric based on educational need, access to other support, and time-sensitive goals—not personal connections or ability to pay. Use a lottery when applicants have equal priority. Explain available volunteer hours, eligibility rules, and decision timelines upfront, making clear that applying does not guarantee tutoring. Maintain a waitlist, offer referrals or shared learning resources where possible, and provide a way to correct application errors. Review outcomes regularly to identify unfair patterns and adjust the process transparently.
